turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Sofia! Happy Friday. How is your day starting out in Phoenix? Are you keeping cool?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! It's already getting pretty warm here, but I'm doing well. I decided to skip the coffee today and whisked up a warm green tea latte with matcha powder and oat milk before heading out. It was a nice, earthy change of pace.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a delicious and calming way to kick off the morning. Did you have a smooth trip to the clinic today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It wasn't too bad! I got behind the wheel of my hybrid and drove myself in. The traffic on the highway was actually moving for once, which is always a pleasant surprise on a Friday.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: It's always a relief when the commute behaves! How have things been going with Tom? Have you guys done any more planning for the summer 2028 wedding lately?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We've taken a little break from the heavy planning this week, to be honest. We're just enjoying the engagement and trying to keep things low-stress. We might look at some venue ideas again this weekend, though.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a very healthy approach. There's plenty of time! Did you get a chance to take a proper lunch break at the clinic today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I did! I packed a lunch today—put together a really tasty sandwich using a couple of thick slices of my own homemade sourdough. It was so satisfying.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Ooh, a sourdough sandwich with your own bread! Your baking hobby is definitely paying off. Was it from a recent bake?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, I baked a fresh boule on Wednesday evening, and it turned out with the perfect crust and chew. Tom loved it too, so we've been working our way through it.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds absolutely perfect. How are your online Italian lessons coming along? Finding any time to practice between work and baking?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've been doing a little bit every evening! I'm slowly getting the hang of the basic grammar. It's tough but really fun. I'm hoping to get some practice in tonight after my shift ends.
